naya.summary: CIS turns experience into durable intelligence through EXPERIENCE → CAPTURE → DISTILL → CONNECT → VERIFY → COMPOUND → APPLY → LEARN AGAIN. Daily reflection compounds into longer-period intelligence.
lessons: GitHub is storage; CIS is the intelligence system.
Naya and Human notes can be two useful views of the same event.
The daily ritual should preserve what matters without attempting to save every word.

human.summary: Naya Power should help people learn, create, accomplish, remember, measure, and improve. The important part of each day should survive so tomorrow starts smarter than today.
lessons: Ask Naya for a daily CIS update.
Use MAXESS to measure learning and reassess progress over time.

evidence: Legacy CIS brief was read in full and migrated into the event-centric system.
